mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as rising demand typically boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth reverses in next month or SPX returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 9.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days, reflecting investor concerns about labor market tightness.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 9.5% or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both the federal funds rate falls below 1% and CPIAUCSL (inflation) remains below 2%, this dual easing signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of FEDFUNDS below 1% and CPIAUCSL below 2% does not correlate with positive 60-day returns or the proxies' relationship weakens over time.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a monthly decline in FEDFUNDS of over 0.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days, as policy easing supports market optimism.
failure_condition: In a late-cycle expansion regime, FEDFUNDS do not fall by >0.5% in a month or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both demand (GDPC1) and labor (PAYEMS) growth surge by over 5% in a month, this dual expansion signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and PAYEMS both rise >5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The simultaneous rise of GDPC1 and PAYEMS by >5% in a month does not correlate with positive 5-day returns or their relationship weakens.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of INDPRO above 100 (indicating strong supply growth) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days, reflecting confidence in production capacity.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross above 100 or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 8% and FEDFUNDS rises above 1%, this conflicting labor and monetary signals predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days, reflecting market uncertainty.
failure_condition: The combination of UNRATE below 8% and FEDFUNDS above 1% does not correlate with negative 20-day returns or the proxies' relationship weakens.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a monthly drop in HOUST (demand) of over 10% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days, signaling reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: In a monetary tightening cycle, HOUST does not fall by >10% in a month or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).
